title: Crypto misuse: HMAC sess_reset double-free on error path
description: wolfssl_hmac_sess_reset() in src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_hmac.c calls wc_HmacFree(), then wc_HmacInit(), then wc_HmacSetKey(). If wc_HmacSetKey() fails (line ~193), it calls wc_HmacFree() to clean up the re-initialized struct and returns an error. ctx->inited is never cleared. The subsequent call to wolfssl_hmac_sess_free() (on fd close or error unwind) calls wc_HmacFree() again on an already-freed Hmac struct → use-after-free / double-free. FIPS consequence: freed crypto state is potentially reused in a subsequent session or left in a partially-valid state that passes wolfCrypt internal pointer checks.
